findings.title: Phone and tablet shoppers cannot use header search or category navigation — both controls are hidden at small breakpoints without replacements
findings.observed: At 390px the header has neither category controls nor search; categories also vanish below 1024px.

findings.title: Shoppers choosing a category are taken to the fitting-room heading instead of its filtered catalog — the nav and tiles scroll to the wrong element
findings.observed: Category clicks scroll to #fitting-room; on phones the mirror and wardrobe precede the grid.

findings.title: Phone shoppers choosing a featured look cannot see the stylist reply — look tiles scroll to the fitting-room heading instead of the chat
findings.observed: Look tiles send a chat message but scroll to #fitting-room; #stylist follows the entire catalog.

findings.title: Shoppers struggle to read listing details and distinguish form controls in the light theme — new gray text and borders lack the required contrast
findings.observed: #8a8a8a text on white is about 3.45:1; #e2e2e2 borders on white are about 1.32:1.

findings.title: Shoppers can see an intermediate outfit after reverting to their saved look — the equal-render-key branch exits before invalidating the in-flight request
findings.observed: Returning to rendered outfit A leaves pending outfit B valid; B can replace A's preview.

findings.title: Shoppers can still see removed gear after a preview update fails — automatic regeneration keeps the previous image displayed
findings.observed: A failed replacement leaves the old outfit image visible after its gear was removed.

findings.title: Shoppers can restore a model with old body proportions after editing measurements — saved looks and render keys do not include the profile
findings.observed: A saved look from the previous measurements remains selectable after editing the profile.

findings.title: Phone shoppers can lose access to the imperial height fields — two full-width number inputs and a fixed-width toggle share an unwrapping row without min-width relief
findings.observed: The feet and inches fields use w-full in a flex row beside a 112px non-shrinking toggle.

findings.title: Shoppers can select sold-out gear and then lose their try-on — the catalog and equip controls do not enforce in_stock
findings.observed: Sold-out items remain equipable; try-on rejects their IDs with 409.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot compare item lengths from the catalog and one listing has no length anywhere — cards omit length and the circlet seed leaves it empty
findings.observed: Catalog cards show sizes but not length; the circlet's length is null.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot retake a camera selfie in the fitting room — the replacement control only opens file upload
findings.observed: New photo opens the file picker; camera capture is unavailable after the first selfie.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot identify or open the listings pictured in the hero and featured looks — the storefront uses standalone images instead of catalog-backed gear
findings.observed: The hero and four look tiles use fixed image URLs with no catalog listing references.

findings.title: Desktop shoppers can see clipped selfie actions in the narrow mirror — the two unwrapping buttons exceed the quarter-width column
findings.observed: At 1280px two nonwrapping selfie buttons share a quarter-width mirror with 64px inner padding.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot tell why a long stylist request is rejected — the input has no length limit and validation errors are reported as an unavailable assistant
findings.observed: Messages over 1000 characters receive a generic unavailable-assistant error after 422.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose an entire carefully assembled selection with one click — Clear all deletes worn and set-aside items without confirmation or undo
findings.observed: Clear all immediately removes worn and set-aside items with no confirmation or undo.

findings.title: A shopper's newer wardrobe choice can be set aside when an older stylist reply arrives — late equip operations overwrite the current category
findings.observed: A late stylist equip replaces a newer manual selection in the same category.

findings.title: Shoppers can receive unfitting gear after updating their measurements — in-flight stylist results are applied without checking the current profile
findings.observed: An assistant reply based on the old measurements can equip gear after the profile changes.

findings.title: Shoppers' stylist choices silently stop working after a temporary catalog error — the ID lookup is never retried even if the visible grid later loads
findings.observed: A failed initial all-products request leaves byId empty even if filtered catalog requests succeed.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot find a suggested listing in the catalog grid — recommendations do not clear or reconcile filters that hide highlighted items
findings.observed: A highlighted item remains hidden if existing category, color or other filters exclude it.

findings.title: Shoppers turning off the fit filter still cannot see all catalog gear — the automatically applied gender filter remains active
findings.observed: Turning off Only gear that fits me leaves the automatically set gender filter active.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose catalog filtering after a malformed stylist reply — filter values are accepted as arbitrary strings rather than checked against each field's type
findings.observed: An invalid stylist max_price string is merged into filters and causes product requests to fail.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose their selected outfit on a malformed stylist reply — coercing the string "false" with bool makes clear_all true
findings.observed: A model response with clear_all set to the string "false" clears the entire outfit.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot remove an existing catalog filter by voice or chat — the stylist treats null as unchanged and response cleanup discards it before merging
findings.observed: Null filter values from the model are discarded and never clear the existing filters.

findings.title: Budget shoppers cannot select exact price limits — the maximum-price filter only allows $5 increments
findings.observed: The price slider advances in $5 increments rather than allowing an exact price.

findings.title: Shoppers see permanently blank category tiles after a transient catalog error — tile images depend on an initial all-products request that is never retried
findings.observed: If the initial all-products request fails, all four category tile images remain empty.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot identify their size for individual listings — the drawer uses a generic body size even when the item lacks it, and cards show only size ranges
findings.observed: The drawer highlights a generic body size even when the item's listed sizes exclude it.

findings.title: Marketplace shoppers lose sight of equipped items in new categories — the wardrobe and checkout enumerate only eight hardcoded slots
findings.observed: Only the eight SLOT_ORDER categories are shown in the selection and checkout totals.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose the preview and leave the camera active after closing the dialog — a late camera permission grant is not stopped on cleanup
findings.observed: A camera permission grant after dialog cleanup leaves the newly granted stream running.

findings.title: Shoppers can capture an empty selfie before the camera is ready — capture is enabled before video dimensions are available
findings.observed: Capture is enabled before videoWidth and videoHeight are populated.

findings.title: Phone shoppers can lose the camera capture control in landscape — the centered camera dialog has no viewport height limit or scroll
findings.observed: The centered camera dialog has no viewport-height cap or vertical scroll.

findings.title: Shoppers without camera API support see a black camera instead of an upload instruction — the unavailable-API branch sets no error
findings.observed: When mediaDevices is unavailable, the dialog renders a black video and no error.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose a centimetre and receive incorrect fit results just by switching height units — conversion rounds to whole inches and overwrites the original value
findings.observed: Switching 100 cm to feet/inches and back can save 99 cm due to whole-inch rounding.

findings.title: Shoppers lose catalog filter options after a temporary facets error — the initial request suppresses errors and has no retry
findings.observed: A transient facets failure silently leaves category and other filter options empty.

findings.title: Shoppers can see a broken preview instead of an error — generated image data is neither decoded and validated nor given a load-error fallback
findings.observed: A malformed image data URL is stored as the preview and shown without an image error fallback.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot readily identify the outfit piece blocking a preview — the 409 error exposes catalog IDs instead of marking and naming selected items
findings.observed: A 409 availability error names item IDs rather than the selected items shoppers recognize.

findings.title: Shoppers choosing a featured look before the catalog finishes loading can receive a reply but no outfit — equip actions are applied against an empty listing lookup
findings.observed: If a look reply arrives before allProducts, its equip IDs are ignored and never replayed.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot browse cloaks, boots, shields or accessories from the storefront category navigation or tiles — both use a fixed four-category list
findings_minor.observed: Cloaks, boots, shields and accessories exist in the catalog but have no nav control or tile.

findings_minor.title: Keyboard users cannot compare their generated look with the original selfie — the compare button only handles pointer events
findings_minor.observed: The Hold for original button has no keyboard or click handler.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see a dark Get the look section in the light storefront — the entire section is explicitly styled black
findings_minor.observed: Get the look is rendered with bg-black and text-white, not the requested light theme.

findings_minor.title: A pasted long URL can overflow the stylist chat on a phone — message bubbles do not break long words
findings_minor.observed: A single long unbroken chat message has no word-breaking rule in the message bubble.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers do not see which measurement fields are required or errors beside them — the dialog has only a single form-level message
findings_minor.observed: The measurement form shows only one form-level error, with no required indicators.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot review their measurements in their chosen units — the profile discards unit preferences and the tag always uses metric
findings_minor.observed: Saving imperial input displays the measurement tag only in cm and kg.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers can accidentally discard a new selfie before entering measurements — the required dialog can be dismissed instead of keeping the user in the form
findings_minor.observed: Cancel, Escape or closing the measurements dialog discards the pending selfie.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot use Reset after a zero-price stylist filter — the active-filter check treats zero as inactive
findings_minor.observed: With only max_price=0 active, the Reset filters button is absent.

findings_minor.title: Phone shoppers tapping Outfit are taken to the mirror instead of their selected items — the header button targets the fitting-room heading
findings_minor.observed: Outfit button scrolls to #fitting-room; the selection strip is farther down in the catalog.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers can lose sight of the item drawer's close control over dark product photos — the black X is placed directly on the image without a contrast background
findings_minor.observed: The drawer close X is black over the product photo and has no contrasting backing.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see a blank catalog while products load — the loading flag suppresses the empty message but renders no progress indicator
findings_minor.observed: While the product request is pending, no loading message or progress indicator is rendered.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers get no feedback when the browser cannot read their chosen photo — the file reader has no error or abort handler
findings_minor.observed: A FileReader error or abort has no handler, so the chosen photo gives no feedback.

findings_minor.title: Voice users receive no explanation when microphone access or recognition fails — the speech error handler only resets state
findings_minor.observed: Speech recognition errors stop the mic without explaining the failure to the shopper.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see inconsistent price precision across the fitting room — only catalog cards format item prices to two decimal places
findings_minor.observed: A $68 item appears as $68.00 on its card but $68 in its drawer and wardrobe.
